Jo (AE): Strata CoPilot confirmed a 36h joint pilot next Tue. Need runbook, scoping (routes + QPS), and a short Dedicated vs hosted cost note.
Evan (Partner Eng): I'll take runbook + routing. What routes do they care about?
Strata PM (via Jo): primary: /v1/chat (low-latency), /v1/embeds (bulk), sampling telemetry to their Splunk. Peak: ~120 rps chat, 80 qps embeds.
Ruth (Solutions): Recommend per-route caps: chat 150rps cap with 50 concurrent, embeds batch window 50ms. Provide example routing JSON and curl snippets.
Omar (Infra): For infra, suggest small Dedicated reserve + hosted fallback. Ballpark commit: $30k/mo for baseline. Will post spreadsheet. Need their CIDR for peering.
Priya (Security): They asked about SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and data handling for pilot. We support SAML + SCIM; pilot will use scoped SCIM token and masked data. I'll upload redacted Q&A.
partner-bot: Tenant request (strata-pilot-01) created by Jo at 1777001120.
Evan (Partner Eng): Draft runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/strata-pilot (draft). Includes VPC peering steps and token rotation schedule.
Omar (Infra): Peering created at 1777001400. Added telemetry allowlist and port 9090.
Ruth (Solutions): Pricing note posted: hosted ~1.6x Dedicated for their profile; embeddings batching can swing cost by 20-40%.
Priya (Security): Q&A uploaded: https://redwood.internal/security/strata-qna (redacted). Supports customer-managed KMS on Private.
Jo (AE): Action list: Evan runbook, Omar capacity sheet, Priya Q&A, Ruth pricing calc. Sync with Strata PM Wed 9am PT. Flag blockers with :rotating_light:.
Evan (Partner Eng): Will hand over short-lived API keys the morning of pilot.
Jo (AE): Thanks team. Keep updates short here.
